scenario_configure_node.description: Updates the configuration of a node in the active SpikyPanda graph. Read spk://scenario first to learn the node ids, then pass nodeId (or opId) and a `config` whose keys match the target op's attrSchema. Values are written both to the persisted config and to the live executor instance.

properties.nodeId: Instance id (e.g. 'node_3'). Wins over opId. Discover via spk://scenario.
properties.opId: Op id (e.g. 'spk.MotorPMSM', 'spk.FaultPmsm.Imbalance'). Resolves to the first node in the graph with that op.
properties.config: Map of attrSchema keys. Example: { speedTargetRps: 50 } sets target speed to 50 rps (= 50 Hz mechanical, omega = 2*pi*50 rad/s, period 20 ms).

scenario_describe_op.description: Returns the full op definition: input/output ports, attrSchema with units and bounds, defaultConfig. Call before configure to validate keys.

sim_run.description: Advances the simulation by `seconds` seconds. Enters play mode if needed. Allow at least 3 s before the first read: FOC settling < 0.3 s, then 5*tau of the SyncDetect LPF (at 5 Hz, tau = 200 ms, so 1 s for 5 tau).

properties.seconds: Wall-clock duration. Minimum 3 s. Budget 5 to 10 s when averaging the lock-in beat caused by FOC speed ripple.

sim_toggle_gravity.description: Enables or disables the spk.WorldGravity source. Discriminative test: a signal that collapses to zero at OFF and returns at ON is entirely gravity-driven. This is how the gravitational signature on accel_x was confirmed in gravity_sync_detect_results.md.

properties.enabled: true = Earth gravity (1 g), false = microgravity (0 g).

measure_read_amplitudes.description: Returns the latest sample of every active float stream, keyed by '<label>.<port>'. This is where SyncDetect magnitude is read: a stable value matching theory means the lock-in is correctly locked.

measure_read_fft_peak.description: Reads the magnitude of the FFT bin closest to freqHz. Resolution = Fs / N: at Fs = 5000 Hz, N = 8192, df = 0.61 Hz. Increase windowHz to absorb 1 to 3 neighbouring bins when the peak shifts due to speed ripple.

properties.channel: FFT node label or stream key (e.g. 'FFT.spectrum').
properties.freqHz: Target frequency. At 50 rps: f_mech = 50 Hz, 2*f_mech = 100 Hz (static eccentricity), BPFO ~ 87.3 Hz (5-ball bearing, 0 deg contact angle).
properties.windowHz: Half-width window in Hz. Default = one bin. Safe value: 2*df = 1.2 Hz.

measure_export_data.description: Returns the full Float32Array contents of every stream, serialized as JSON. Heavy payload (megabytes possible); call once per experiment, never in a tight loop.

log_experiment.description: Persists one experiment record under ~/spikypanda-research/experiments/: scenario (motor config, gravity, faults), measurements (amplitudes, FFT peaks, deltas), notes. Primary trace feeding both the DotVision dataset and reports.

properties.scenario: Exact configuration snapshot: motor preset, target speed, gravity state, active faults (id + severity).
properties.notes: Free text: observations, biases detected, special conditions.

write_hypothesis.description: Creates or replaces a hypothesis markdown document. Use to track an open question: what is assumed, how to verify, which result would settle it.

properties.name: Short document name (no extension).
properties.content: Full markdown body. Include a 'verification' section with the experiment plan.

write_report.description: Creates or replaces a markdown report under ~/spikypanda-research/reports/. Authored by the agent from experiments and hypotheses; the MCP is a store, never a writer.

properties.name: Short report name (no extension).
properties.content: Full markdown body. Recommended layout: title, context, protocol, results table, interpretation, next step.

add_dataset_entry.description: Appends one row to the dataset manifest (~/spikypanda-research/dataset/manifest.json). One entry = one labeled sample ready for NN training.

properties.label: Sample class (e.g. 'D1_imbalance_0p5_gravity_on'). Convention: <fault>_<severity>_gravity_<on|off>.
properties.features: Scalar feature vector: { accel_x_1x_mag: 0.0035, iq_1x_mag: 0.0008, accel_x_2x_mag: 0.0001, ... }.
properties.source: Pointer back to the raw measurement (experiment id, file path).
